publicVideo.title: How to Set Up a Lightning Wallet in Nostr WoT
publicVideo.descriptionSummary: Compares Quick Setup, Nostr Wallet Connect and LNbits, including the connection details and permissions each method needs.

websiteEvidence.directBrowserResult: The production URL returned a generic Site Unavailable edge page during this run and was not treated as live-page evidence.

practicalProblem: Helps readers choose among Quick Setup, NWC and LNbits API access, understand which credential can spend, and verify permissions, expiry and wallet history before retrying an uncertain payment.
